title: JLG Scissor/Boom Lifts
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE AIR FORCE.PACIFIC AIR FORCES.FA5025  356 ECEG PK
detail_text: The Government is only conducting market research and attaining information to identify contractors that are able to provide all items/services listed below and the cost associated to acquire these specific items/services. All information provided is STRICLY VOLUNTARY. This requirement is for procurement of five scissor lifts, model JLG RT3369. Salient Characteristics: - Minimum 30 foot working height lift - Diesel engine meeting EPA emissions standards - Tired equipment, rough terrain capabilities This requirement is for procurement of a boom lift, model JLG 600S. Salient Characteristics: - Minimum 50 foot boom lift - Diesel engine meeting EPA emissions standards - Tired equipment, 4WD capabilities **These assets being received need shipping to Guam with DBIBS access to Andersen AFB: 513 ERHS Bldg 61315, Northwest Field Yigo, GU 96929 USA
